correctness.rationale: PASS: An injective rank n−1 nilpotent partial map is one directed Hamiltonian chain. Orientation preservation means the increasing domain and image lists correspond by a cyclic index shift t. Rotate terminal omitted domain a to n−1; extend by mapping a to missing image b to get π_t=π_0 (0 1 … n−2)^t with π_0=(b b+1 … n−1). For even n, parity forces b even, equivalent to odd circular separation d. Explicit t=1 orbit forms an n-cycle whenever b has parity n, and a reflection fills the remaining offsets for odd n; sign restriction is therefore sufficient and necessary. At adjacent endpoints, contracting the prescribed arrow yields an (n−1)-point cyclic translation by t+1, single cycle iff gcd(t+1,n−1)=1, giving φ(n−1) per neighbor. Independently enumerated all n! directed Hamiltonian paths for 3≤n≤7, confirming attainable pairs and exact neighboring fibres. The all-n result relies on the permutation proof.
